integrity: The proof separates no-carry and carry doubling. No carry contradicts the two cycle equations by cubic homogeneity. A carry plus the first cycle equation forces b<=8. The remaining 68 digit pairs are exhaustively enumerated; only base 8 with X=27 satisfies the first equation, and it fails the return equation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to exponent 3, exact ratio 2, and cycles in which both members have exactly two base-b digits. It does not classify other cubic two-cycles or cycles with a member of three or more digits. The finite residue after the analytic cutoff consists of 68 admissible digit pairs and is exhaustively replayable. The 2010 primary paper has no exact public calendar day in the inspected evidence, so the stored date is the earliest exact public date verified among the inspected archival sources.
title: No two-digit doubling two-cycle for the cubic happy map
